ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-18-2011 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: JUDGE ELLEN CHAITIN Clerk: Jacque Willis-McGhee Reporter: G. CASEY, #8098

This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of Two Minors.
Dept. 514, JUDGE ELLEN CHAITIN, Clerk: J. WILLIS-MCGHEE, CSR: G. CASEY, #8098

Petitioner BRIAN WHITTEN & ROBIN GETTLESON was present in pro per as Guardian ad Litem for the minors RAMONA BEA WHITTEN GETTLESON.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.

Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors to RAMONA BEA WHITTEN.

Decree Changing Names was submitted to and signed by the Court.
